Definition: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
BiblicalUsage: Sha'al is asking, inquiring, requesting — and the two verses show the two ways to ask. Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that Thou wouldest bless me indeed, and God granted him that which he requested. And Saul died for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that asking is only as good as who is asked: Jabez asked God and was granted, and Saul asked the dead and died for it.
